verdict.rationale: The product publishes its own `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` listing describing its skill set (ledger tasks, wiki, workflow, planning, benchmark, Ralph loop), and the README and site enumerate the canonical skills with per-skill names. That gives a small first-party marketplace listing a developer can review before installing. The interactive picker in `npx skills add` belongs to the third-party open `skills` CLI, not to YYLO, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: a searchable registry or catalog with per-skill descriptions, any leaderboard or ranking, documented browse/search UX before install, and independent corroboration.
